text:
hana_opslead: Quick heads-up 12 H100s from vendor dropped from our Q2 allocation. They offered to split: 12 units air-priority to EU, rest by sea. Need CHE decision before EOD to confirm AWBs and depot intake.

mike_procure: Can we get precise uplift costs and whether vendor will absorb any brokerage? Finance needs a one-line justification.

jin_vendor: Short version: air uplift + expedited customs handling = 
c1,900 total (
c160/unit + 
c900 flat brokerage). Sea route saves ~
c120/unit but introduces ~14-21d delay and possible port demurrage. Vendor can waive 
c300 of brokerage if we accept two AWBs (split handling).

mae_logistics: EU depot constraints: if air arrives midday we can clear 8 units same-day, remaining 4 next morning. Need AWBs 24h prior and CI with HS code flagged. Port of entry likely Rotterdam.

hana_opslead: If EU pool loses capacity we trigger auto-fallthrough to US spare pool. How long to ship loaners internally?

mae_logistics: Intercontinental loaner transfer ~48-72h once units leave US depot, plus customs clearance. Not ideal for urgent <72h needs.

jin_vendor: On HS: commercial invoice shows HS 8471.80. Customs at origin queried component list which caused delay. We can push corrected CI within 12-24h.

mike_procure: Any RMA implications if we accept split routing (air in, sea later)? We need to ensure failed units map to vendor RMA flow cleanly.

jin_vendor: Recommended flow: air units get vendor AWB + serials on dispatch. If DOA -> depot uses vendor manifest and we schedule vendor weekly pickup from depot for consolidated returns. If mass failure (>3 units) we can route returns to origin forwarder for faster replacement processing.

hana_opslead: Ops checklist: (1) Pre-authorize 6 intake slots day-of, (2) opsbot to create temporary manifest CSV aligning with vendor schema, (3) depot to print vendor RMA labels on arrival.

opsbot: Created temp manifest template: https://redwood.internal/sops/temp-rma-manifest.csv (columns: serial, model, vendor_awb, depot_location, rma_type). Generated provisional labels: https://redwood.internal/labels/prov-1788099999.csv

mae_logistics: We'll need insurance confirmation. Air shipment should be covered; sea needs marine insured. Jin, confirm insurer and policy numbers.

jin_vendor: Insurer: AtlasCargo. Air policy included; marine policy estimate 
c320 for the container. Policy numbers will be attached to final CI.

mike_procure: Finance preference: accept air split for the 12 prioritized units. Approve up to 
c2k uplift. Please attach AWBs + CI in thread and cc finance.

hana_opslead: Once AWBs land, I want serials in the manifest and a quick ops smoke test (power, NV driver handshake) before routing to production pool. How long for onsite staging?

mae_logistics: Staging time 20hrs per unit for basic checks. We can parallelize up to 6 units.

jin_vendor: Draft AWBs (placeholders):
DHL: 222-55588801
DHL: 222-55588802
FFW: 444-00011122
CI ref: INV-REW-2026-442 (declares HS 8471.80). Uploading supporting component list to shared drive now.

mae_logistics: Booking intake slots for arrival window. Holding 6 slots on day 1 and 6 slots next morning. Need final AWB numbers 24h out to lock.

mike_procure: Also flagging loaner policy: vendor provides 6 temporary loaners free for 10 days. After that 
c180/week per unit. Confirmed?

jin_vendor: Correct. Loaner SKUs reserved.

hana_opslead: Good. Ops will run a health check and if shortage persists enable auto-borrow from US spare pool. Coordinate with SRE on A/B routing so we don't impact SLAs.

mae_logistics: If customs reclass again we fallback to expedited sea via feeder + road; ETA then ~9-11 days and higher inland transit fees.

jin_vendor: Sending finalized CI, insurance PDF, and AWBs to shared drive and email now. Expect upload at ts 1788100125.

opsbot: Noted: manifest template finalized and pre-labels updated. Link: https://redwood.internal/labels/prov-1788099999.csv. Will regenerate labels once final AWBs push.

mike_procure: Finance loop closed. Approved uplift. Proceed with air split. Please keep this thread for final AWBs and depot intake times.

jin_vendor: Files uploaded at 1788100125. Apologies for noise; will monitor customs and update if any classification flags.

opsbot: Thread archived to vendors:shipping at 1788100200.
